units: relative terrain tiers; independent of screen Y
projection: One level equals one 16-pixel tile of front wall. A two-level drop has two front rows. Side edges are four pixels wide and rear rims two pixels; each has matching static collision. Stairs use one row per level. Height plan is user intent; implementation guides describe constructed surfaces.

surfaces.shoreNote: The eastern pond strip remains H0 beside the H-1 basin and extends north to the headland at (65.5,68.5). Permanent banks separate it from the H1 upper grove and basin after drainage; opening the woodland does not create an upper-route shortcut.

surfaces.groveNote: The cleared northern orchard and western spur groves remain H1. Permanent banks along the worksite's east side and southern basin approach retain the drainage gate; the worksite still requires its basin stair. The rocky headland remains inaccessible terrain.

surfaces.approachNote: Same-height dry porch from the ridge stair foot to the south-facing distributor doorway. Physical timber gates control the service passage and main exit; water remains in sluice channels. The former east entry is sealed.

surfaces.note: The user's marked two-column stair rises one level from the drained basin to the doorway. The higher ridge remains sealed; no dry upper-road bypass.

rope.note: The southeast bandit camp occupies a Farm-height clearing inside a wooded Ridge-height bank. The purchased rope crosses only the authored bank segment; walking around the outer loop never enters the camp.

water: High pond floods Basin and lower stair flights; permanent river stays wet. Surface heights do not change on drainage.

outOfBoundsUplands.name: Western approach upland
outOfBoundsUplands.note: Inaccessible top; three-cell fronts and directional banks. Western overscan is render-only. Scene owns the exact footprint.

outOfBoundsUplands.name: Southern pond bluff
outOfBoundsUplands.note: Unwalkable rock enclosure using accepted shared-palette stone. It has no horizontal floor tier, stair, reward or route. Scene guides own its exact footprint.

outOfBoundsUplands.name: Pasture grove
outOfBoundsUplands.note: Compact inaccessible wooded rise south of the orchard ridge. A clear H0 grassy passage separates the two H1 masses; the orchard stairs remain mandatory for the upper route. Scene owns the exact footprint.

authoring: The scene Elevation and Transitions Tilemaps own terrain classification and connection geometry. Surface/structure/void/transition runs are derived exports for the SVG and verification; named surface samples and route contracts remain explicit. No runtime height simulation or whole-scene generation.
